ANA.head: The Ducks should be in control
ANA.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. It’s on the Flames to make it a game, and they can if they keep the shots coming.

CGY.head: The Flames are up against it
CGY.body: Anaheim has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Flames can start with piling up shots, plus Dustin Wolf stealing the show.

story.head: The Flames try again for a first win
paras: The Flames are still looking for their first win of the season, 0-5-0 through five games. The Ducks have won two in a row. The Ducks won the first meeting this season, 4-2 in Calgary.
The Ducks shoot a lot, and the Flames give up plenty. Both teams like a fast game.

items.text: The Flames are newly without Samuel Honzek, have been without Joel Hanley since Oct 3, and have had to make do without Jonathan Huberdeau all season.
The Ducks are newly without Cutter Gauthier, and have had to make do without Troy Terry all season. Counting how much each missing player usually brings, only the Wild are missing more right now.
Leo Carlsson has a point in five straight games against Calgary.
A.J. Greer has missed the Ducks’ latest game.
